claim: An operator handed more operands than it reads is parsed and the extra tokens are ignored. Audited 29/29 by the maintainer as 'not worth reporting', so `analyse` no longer emits it. Kept as a negative record.
why: LogicOp.java: unary ops take one operand; LParser discards the rest. Corpus: 1,121 of these on 9 downloaded maps were 96% of all warnings, so this class must never outrank a real finding.
